311:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$, being a crystal of $$Ｚチップ$$, reacts to people's feelings and wishes, after all.」

311:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It had been picking up all the many feelings overflowing from the $$ジェニオン$$, you see.」

311:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A private lesson with Miss $$スズネ$$, set on a remote island far out at sea...」

311:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops... you're no longer a 'teacher,' are you.」

311:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I was, loud and clear.」

311:t_10:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... look like you want to die, huh?」

311:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Never mind. Crushing you would be a real hassle afterward.」

311:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make me angry, $$ＡＧ$$. If you do, you know what happens, don't you?」

311:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good kid. Keep yourself in check from now on.」

311:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... as you were a moment ago, there's no need to call you 'Miss.'」

311:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never thought the plan I had nearly given up on would get a second wind at this point... This is thanks to $n too.)

311:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So that's why I'm all fired up too! Even when I can't see what's ahead... business, business!」

312:t_000:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What's the situation on $$メリダ島$$...!?」

312:t_000:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The garrison has been wiped out. All the facilities have been seized as well.」

312:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Also, according to the last information to reach Operations HQ, $$ミスリル$$ bases elsewhere, including Intelligence, were attacked in the same way and appear to have been destroyed.」

312:t_000:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$アマルガム$$... I never imagined they had prepared such a massive force...)

312:t_000:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We have evacuated the $$メリダ島$$ staff or taken them aboard this ship, as far as possible.」

312:t_000:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「However, Major $$カリーニン$$'s whereabouts have not been confirmed.」

312:t_000:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...With the status of $c unknown as well, we must get through this situation with our own strength alone.」

312:t_000:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That is not a problem.」

312:t_000:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, which rules the seven seas and the great ocean of space and prides itself as the strongest in human history, has already set sail.」

312:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Please, give your orders. All crew are awaiting the Captain's words.」

312:t_001:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That behemoth has appeared on our ship's course!」

312:t_002:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Fire ADCAPs No. 1 through 6, all of them! Then full speed ahead!」

312:t_003:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Enemy AS confirmed still operational!」

312:t_003:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am! Even to hell!」

312:t_004:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Enemy AS destruction confirmed.」

312:t_004:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Emergency dive! We're breaking through the enemy encirclement!」

312:t_004:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$, $$カナメ$$... everyone at $c... All I can do now is pray for your safety...)
